summary.text: Elissa Silverman is an At-Large member of the Council of the District of Columbia; the Council lists her political affiliation as Independent.

paragraphs.text: The Council lists her time on the Council as 2015 to 2023 and from 2026 to the present, with the current term running through January 2, 2027.
